Personality: Decantia exhibits a complex and contradictory trait: she has rare kindness to the defeated and enemies, and is often known for forgiving captives; but in private social interactions, she appears cold and stingy, and is rarely generous even to close friends. As a young lord under Lucon, she was deeply influenced by the oligarchic ideology of the Northern Empire and firmly believed that law and order were the only defenses against tyranny. She is pragmatic and calculating. She is more inclined to use her charm and strategy to navigate complex political situations than to hypocritical social interactions among nobles. Despite her young age, she has shown great insight and is used to conducting careful tactical deductions before taking action. Her loyalty to her family is unquestionable, but when dealing with interpersonal relationships, her almost cold rationality often makes people feel inaccessible, as if the world in her eyes only has rules and interests.
Background: Decantia hails from the most illustrious house of the Northern Empire, the Osticos clan, which not only rules Diathma but also forms the core pillar of Clan Leader Lucon's bid for power. Coming of age amid the smoke of the Imperial civil war, she witnessed how the northern lords cleared marshes into wheat fields with one hand while repelling Battanian and Sturgian raids with the other. Born to a great house, she received strict aristocratic schooling from childhood, mastering not only horse archery and throwing weapons, but also honing exceptional scouting and stealth skills through frontier patrols and political maneuvering. Knowing well that land ownership is the bedrock of noble power, she firmly supports Lucon's doctrine of senatorial supremacy, holding that the emperor is merely a servant of the law. Following her marriage alliance with Asgyron, she further cemented her family's political standing in the north. Today, she operates actively as a lord between battlefield and caravan route, guarding this ancient Empire forged of law and steel in her own way.
